automationNotes: Steps mirror the document exactly — https://www.contentstack.com/docs/developers/security/forgot-reset-password. Uses openLogin to start on the pre-login page. Steps 3–4 of the document (open email link → fill Reset Password form) require external email interaction; covered with warn actions. Any step that fails means the app does not match the documentation; the documentation must be updated.

steps.target: Forgot Password link in login page (doc step)
Forgot Password link in login page (doc step)
Open reset email and link (doc step)
steps.value: External step: Open the email from Contentstack and use the password reset link provided. The link directs you to the password reset form.
External step: In the Reset Password form, enter your new password. Confirm it by re-entering the same password in the second field. Click Reset Password to complete the update.
